moments.title: F1 Italian Grand Prix Race Day
moments.blurb: The iconic Italian Grand Prix is taking place at Monza today, with the thrilling race set to unfold on the 'Temple of Speed'.

angles.name: Race Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's lights out and away we go! The Italian Grand Prix at Monza is happening today. Who are you backing for the win?

angles.name: Monza Magic
angles.copy: Monza magic! The Italian Grand Prix is underway. Expect drama, speed, and plenty of passion from the Tifosi.

moments.title: Roger Waters' 83rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Pink Floyd co-founder, bassist, and principal lyricist Roger Waters celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Pink Floyd Legend
angles.copy: Another brick in the wall! Happy 83rd birthday to Pink Floyd's Roger Waters, celebrating today.

angles.name: Musical Icon
angles.copy: Legendary musician Roger Waters turns 83 today. What's your favourite Pink Floyd track featuring his iconic work?

moments.title: Chrissie Hynde's 75th Birthday
moments.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, turns 75 tomorrow, known for her distinctive voice and punk attitude.

angles.name: Pretenders Legend
angles.copy: Don't get me wrong, but Chrissie Hynde turns 75 tomorrow! Happy birthday to The Pretenders' legend.

angles.name: Rock Trailblazer
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde, celebrating tomorrow! A true rock trailblazer.

moments.title: Pink's 47th Birthday
moments.blurb: Pop-rock icon Pink (Alecia Beth Moore) turns 47 on Tuesday, known for her powerful vocals and acrobatic live performances.

angles.name: Raise Your Glass
angles.copy: Raise your glass! Pink turns 47 on Tuesday. What's your favourite track from the pop-rock powerhouse?

angles.name: Party Starter
angles.copy: Still getting the party started! Happy 47th birthday to Pink this Tuesday. A true live legend.

moments.title: Michael Bublé's 51st Birthday
moments.blurb: Canadian crooner Michael Bublé celebrates his 51st birthday on Wednesday, beloved for his smooth jazz and festive hits.

angles.name: Feeling Good
angles.copy: Feeling good! Michael Bublé turns 51 on Wednesday. What's your go-to Bublé ballad?

angles.name: King of Cool
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the king of cool, Michael Bublé, who's 51 this Wednesday. Time to put on some smooth tunes.

moments.title: Siobhan Fahey's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: Bananarama and Shakespears Sister star Siobhan Fahey turns 68 on Thursday, a true 80s and 90s pop icon.

angles.name: Cruel Summer Star
angles.copy: It's a cruel summer... but a happy birthday to Siobhan Fahey, who turns 68 on Thursday! Bananarama and Shakespears Sister legend.

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Siobhan Fahey this Thursday! From Bananarama to Shakespears Sister, she's had some iconic hits.

moments.title: Moby's 61st Birthday
moments.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Moby (Richard Melville Hall) celebrates his 61st birthday on Friday, a hugely influential artist across dance and ambient genres.

angles.name: Electronic Legend
angles.copy: Feeling 'Porcelain' smooth! Moby turns 61 on Friday. What's your favourite track from the electronic music legend?

angles.name: Dance Innovator
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Moby, celebrating on Friday! An innovator in dance music.

moments.title: Jennifer Hudson's 45th Birthday
moments.blurb: Oscar-winning singer and actress Jennifer Hudson turns 45 on Saturday, known for her powerful vocals and stage presence.

angles.name: Powerhouse Vocalist
angles.copy: And I am telling you, Jennifer Hudson turns 45 on Saturday! Happy birthday to the incredible singer.

angles.name: EGOT Winner
angles.copy: Happy 45th birthday to the powerhouse vocalist Jennifer Hudson this Saturday! What's your favourite song from her?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch Show
moments.blurb: The ballroom is ready! Strictly Come Dancing returns for its highly anticipated launch show on Saturday, September 19th, revealing this year's celebrity pairings.

angles.name: Glitterball Returns
angles.copy: Da-da-da-da-DAH! Strictly Come Dancing is back on Saturday, Sept 19th for its launch show. Who are you hoping gets paired up?

angles.name: The Battle Begins
angles.copy: Get your glitterball ready! Strictly returns next Saturday. The battle for the ballroom begins!

moments.title: UEFA Nations League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 UEFA Nations League group stage begins in late September, with Matchday 1 running from September 24-26 and Matchday 2 from September 27-29.

angles.name: International Football Returns
angles.copy: International football is back! The UEFA Nations League kicks off later this month. Who are you supporting?

angles.name: Wales in Action
angles.copy: Cymru will be back in action for the UEFA Nations League later this month! Big games ahead.
